---
name: Audit roadmap against code
description: Verify planned and completed work against actual runtime consumers, tests, generated content, and live evidence.
argument-hint: Roadmap section or content/runtime family to audit.
agent: Cypher Foundry VTT Expert
---

Audit the requested roadmap scope against the current branch. Do not infer
completion from record presence, field names, commit titles, or unchecked boxes.

Trace source records, DataModels, pure rules, services, sheet actions, tests,
and available live evidence. Report each mechanic as stored, resolved/presented,
runtime-connected, automatically tested, or live-verified; these are separate
criteria. Give file references and source/model dependencies for remaining work.

Recommend the next concrete implementation lot. Edit the roadmap only when
requested, and preserve completed history. Do not launch builds merely to
answer an audit question.
